text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"asks a question and gives a clear stance in the opening paragraph","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states an arguable position early so the reader knows exactly where the essay stands."},{"evidence":"explains accidents, boredom, and loss of driving skill","quality":"reasoned support","description":"It develops several distinct reasons for its position instead of mainly listing facts."},{"evidence":"“What happens when the computers crash though?” and “Humans tend to sleep when they get bored”","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"It anticipates weaknesses in driverless cars and uses them to strengthen the argument."},{"evidence":"“I believe we can reach a happy median without giving computers full control”","quality":"nuanced stance","description":"It presents a more balanced position rather than a one-sided absolute claim."},{"evidence":"“In conclusion I do not think driverless cars are a good thing”","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by restating the claim and briefly summarizing the main concern."}]}
